name: gvdb.wasm
description: GVDB (GVariant Database) key-value store compiled to WebAssembly

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:js
scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p wasm-build && cd wasm-build && emcc -O3 -std=c11 -s WASM=1 -s MODULARIZE=1 -s EXPORT_ES6=1 -s EXPORTED_FUNCTIONS='["_gvdb_wasm_create", "_gvdb_wasm_free", "_gvdb_wasm_set", "_gvdb_wasm_get", "_gvdb_wasm_has_key", "_gvdb_wasm_remove", "_gvdb_wasm_get_keys", "_gvdb_wasm_size", "_gvdb_wasm_clear", "_gvdb_wasm_serialize", "_gvdb_wasm_deserialize", "_gvdb_wasm_free_keys_array", "_gvdb_wasm_free_buffer", "_gvdb_wasm_performance_test", "_malloc", "_free"]' -s EXPORTED_RUNTIME_METHODS='["ccall", "cwrap", "UTF8ToString", "stringToUTF8", "lengthBytesUTF8"]' -s INITIAL_MEMORY=16MB -s MAXIMUM_MEMORY=256MB -s ALLOW_MEMORY_GROWTH=1 -s STACK_SIZE=1MB -s ASSERTIONS=0 --closure 1 -DEMSCRIPTEN_KEEPALIVE ../wasm/wasm_module.c -o gvdb.js

author: WASM Ecosystem Contributors
